players.product: Recursion OS, biological foundation models, and Lab-in-the-Loop drug engine

quarterly_data.signal: The AI-native product engine combines more than 50 petabytes of proprietary multimodal data, foundation models and experimental validation. Management said the labs run about two million experiments each week; a neuroscience atlas for Roche-Genentech used more than one trillion iPSC-derived neurons, hundreds of billions of microglia and signatures from more than 17,000 genes.

Drug-design efficiency: candidates are being advanced with roughly 330 synthesized compounds over about 1.5 years versus an industry benchmark of roughly 2,500 compounds over four years. REC-7735 was designed in 10 months using 242 compounds across 13 cycles and is nearly 130x selective over wild type.
quarterly_data.figure: ~330 compounds / 1.5 years vs ~2,500 / 4 years; REC-7735: 242 compounds, 13 cycles, 10 months

quarterly_data.signal: Agentic workflows are in production across biology, chemistry and clinical development. The chemistry design agent compresses structural-analysis cycles from roughly four hours to about 30 minutes, while clinical workflows are contributing to approximately 1.3x-1.6x better enrollment versus historical benchmarks. Nesso-1 delivers stated Boltz-2-level accuracy with 10x-20x faster inference.

Partnerships have generated more than $500 million of realized cash inflows and more than a dozen discovery milestones. Cash and equivalents were approximately $557 million, supporting runway through early 2028; 2026 cash operating expense guidance was reduced to $375 million, nearly 40% below comparable 2024 pro forma expense.
quarterly_data.figure: >$500M partnership inflows; cash ~$557M; runway early 2028; 2026 cash OpEx $375M

contracts.signal: Recursion achieved its fifth Sanofi milestone on a novel lead series for a challenging first-in-class oncology target and expects potential nomination of an oral immunology-and-inflammation development candidate.
contracts.value: included in >$500M total realized partnership inflows

connects_to.relationship: AI-discovered neuroscience targets and joint drug discovery

contracts.signal: Genentech advanced the collaboration's first previously unexplored neuroscience target into a joint early-discovery program. Recursion reported more than $260 million in upfront and milestone payments to date and potential for more than $300 million of additional development, commercialization and sales milestones for each future small-molecule program.
